redemption_acceptance_for_value_schemes.value: Fraudulent scheme asserting the US government has trust accounts linked to each citizen ('redemption' / 'acceptance for value'). Individuals use fraudulent Treasury-related financial obligations or fictitious promissory notes / bonds to attempt purchases (commonly vehicles). Fraudsters hold seminars (in-person and on YouTube) teaching attendees how to create fictitious documents and misuse federal routing numbers.
